name: Engineers Anywhere Postcard
theme: Recruitment / mission postcard: engineering talent is everywhere in San Diego, and the League wants to find it. Cinematic graphic-novel energy.

name: Fun Friends In A Future
theme: Branding image: two kids coding together at a laptop, reimagined as a warm 1940s golden-age comic panel. Headline "FUN FRIENDS IN A FUTURE", a kid's speech balloon about coding being fun and building real skills, and a large League of Amazing Programmers wordmark in the lower right.

name: Hello World Postcard
theme: Learning to code is the start of a great career — and it's fun. Postcard for The League of Amazing Programmers.

name: League Figures Emblem
theme: Emblem lock-up: the five-figures-with-flag silhouette in the center, "THE LEAGUE" arced above, "AMAZING PROGRAMMERS" arced below in curved text.

name: League Logo Angled
theme: Type sample (black-and-white structural reference) for the angled/diagonal-banner League of Amazing Programmers logo.

name: League Logo Horizontal
theme: Type sample (black-and-white structural reference) for the horizontal League of Amazing Programmers logo.

name: Robot Riot Postcard
theme: Robot Riot — combat-robotics event postcard; classic fight-night ring composition with battling Cutebots and modern kids

name: Take Us To Your Leader Postcard
theme: Advocate campaign postcard, retro flying-saucer gag. A little spaceship has landed and opened in a warm office; the 'aliens' who step out are recognizably a LEAGUE KID and a friendly HUMANOID ROBOT. They greet a bemused adult and ask to be taken to the leader. Second read: the 'aliens' are your kid and the robot they built — and they want to meet your boss. The ask is one warm introduction.
